description: Morphic-transition C++17 integer online context arithmetic prototype. Builds qm_context_codec_v1.cpp with QM_MORPHIC_TRANSITIONS=1, preserving the v1 table size and mixer profile while switching local state transitions based on a 64-bit bit-density monitor.
notes: Implements Strategy 2 from the advanced pipeline plan.
The entropy window is advanced once per coded bit, then reused by all local context-table mutations for that bit.
verdict: Reject as a standalone compressor. Morpic transitions improved the 1 KiB and 64 KiB screens versus v1, but regressed on the exact 1 MiB prefix and remains far behind LZMA.
